text_block_list.name: Journey Fan A
text_block_list.text:
“—Dream Journey's gonna take today's Takarazuka Kinen!
Just look at her stellar run this spring...!
She's undeniably the strongest of our era...!”

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan B
text_block_list.text: It's amazing~ Even though she's the smallest one out there today, look at that popularity...! Everyone's finally realizing how strong she is...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I just had to come watch—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Still, this is a learning experience too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how Journey-san will run.
I can't wait...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I can feel it, even from all the way over here.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: The atmosphere of the Grand Prix... Such frenzy.
choice_data_list: So many fans are waiting for you!
Lots of fans are waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let us deliver our best run,
so we may live up to their hopes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Even so,
I really have changed, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To think that I'd come to care
this much about the fans...

Going to different places, seeing different things,
meeting different people, gaining various experiences, and moving forward—

"In each and every one of them, there are changes—signs of it.
I believe that who Dream Journey is now... is the culmination of her journey."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Changes... accumulation...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no—
Forgive me. I was just lost in thought for a moment...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Depending on today's results, perhaps――

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Please watch closely.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Today, what my running will bring...
What that truly is—

As Dream Journey uttered those words, the light in her eyes
held a spark... distinctly different from usual.
choice_data_list: I'll be watching closely. As your Trainer

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...That's very reassuring.
